verdict.rationale: Algolia documents an official MCP server, listed in its docs navigation and probed in its official skills repo. That server covers search, analytics, and recommendations. Official agent skills also cover index configuration, plus indices, settings, rules, and synonyms through the CLI. Missing for 10: in-depth MCP server documentation (tool list, setup, auth), explicit confirmation that index write/management operations are exposed through the MCP server itself rather than via the CLI skill, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
